_comment: THIS is the file you tune. Geography decides what is kept; keywords decide the ranking.

countries._note: A job is kept if it matches one of these countries. Delete any you do not want.
countries._regions_note: Catches adverts that only say 'West Africa' or 'Middle East' with no country.
countries._unknown_note: Set true to also keep adverts with no location at all (adds noise, but catches lazy postings).

roles._must_any_note: EMPTY = keep every in-geography job at these companies (recommended to start). Once you see the volume, put YOUR discipline here, e.g. ['piping','welding','qa/qc','inspector'] and only those are kept.
roles._exclude_note: Any advert containing one of these is thrown away. Add 'intern', 'graduate', 'apprentice' if you only want experienced roles.
roles._boost_note: Ranking only, never filtering. Higher number = higher in the report. Add your own trade words with a big weight so your roles float to the top.

boost._negatives_note: Negative weights push things down without removing them.

_min_score_note: Raise to 45-60 once you have a feel for scores, to cut the tail.
_age_note: 0 disables the age cut. Many sites publish no date; those are always kept.
